## Datasets I've built

::: {.project}
**Russian election fraud measures, 2000--2024**\
[91 regions · 12 federal elections]{.project-meta}\
A region-by-election panel for every federal election since 2000: turnout and vote totals alongside the standard statistical fraud indicators (abnormal turnout, integer-percentage spikes, last-digit tests, and the Klimek and Shpilkin estimates, among others), all computed from the same precinct-level results.
:::

::: {.project}
**Party presence in Russia's regions, 2008--2025**\
[five Duma parties · region by year]{.project-meta}\
How present United Russia, the KPRF, the LDPR, A Just Russia and New People are on the ground in each region, combining registered branches, archived party websites, regional Telegram channels, mapped party offices, and single-member-district contests.
:::

::: {.project}
**Russian region code crosswalk**\
[one row per region]{.project-meta}\
Links the region identifier I use across projects to region names in English and Russian, licence-plate codes, OKATO and OKTMO codes, and federal districts.
:::

::: {.project}
**Russian governors, 1991--2026**\
[region by year · 88 regions]{.project-meta}\
Who governed each region in each year, with how they came to office (elected or appointed), party membership, security-service background, gender, birth year, and tenure.
:::

::: {.project}
**Russian mayors, 1989--2026**\
[220 large cities]{.project-meta}\
The heads of Russia's large cities since 1989, with each city's system for choosing its head and when that system changed.
:::

## Russian data I use

- [Levada Center](https://www.levada.ru/en/): independent Russian polling.
- [VTsIOM](https://wciom.ru/): Russia's state-owned pollster.
- [FOM](https://fom.ru/): the Public Opinion Foundation.
- [Roper Center](https://ropercenter.cornell.edu/): archive that holds VTsIOM survey microdata.
- [Precinct-level Russian election results](https://github.com/dkobak/elections): Dmitry Kobak's repository, federal elections since 2000.
- [EMISS](https://www.fedstat.ru/): Rosstat's official statistics portal.
- [GADM](https://gadm.org/maps/RUS.html): administrative boundaries.
